_about: EX-era theme decks of ex9 Emerald through ex16 Power Keepers, 17 decks (Emerald 2, Unseen Forces 2, Delta Species 2, Legend Maker 2, Holon Phantoms 2, Crystal Guardians 3 incl. Green Cyclone/Storm Surge/Earth Shower, Dragon Frontiers 2, Power Keepers 2). Written 2026-11-26. Lists: Bulbapedia deck pages (MediaWiki API) compared card by card with Serebii's theme-deck pages (serebii.net/card/themedeck); the two agree on all but a handful of cards (see each deck's notes, Bulbapedia used on conflict). Set ids resolve to data/<set>.json incl. earlier-set reprints (ex1 Energy Search/Potion/Switch, ex6, ex10, ex11, ex12, ex14 Energy Search/Potion, ex13 Metal Energy). Basic Energy is the ex1-104..109 Ruby & Sapphire print for every deck except Mind Game (ex16-107/108): Bulbapedia names RS Energy only for Hydrobloom and Wildfire, Serebii for the rest (single-source print). Real deck holos: Bulbapedia's rarity column shows each deck's featured card as a Cosmos holofoil where the pack print is non-holo (Ho-Oh, Lugia, Latias, Latios, Venusaur, Blastoise, Swampert, Mightyena, Dusclops); the site has no separate print for these, so showcaseTcgplayerId is null everywhere (tcgcsv has no deck-exclusive card products in these groups). Box contents beyond the 60 cards: coin, damage counters, rulebook, card list, single-player mat; no booster pack or code card. TCGplayer sealed products exist for 8 decks only (Hydrobloom, Wildfire, Golden Sky, Silvery Ocean, Breakthrough, Steeplechase, FireMist, FloodRush); none for Legend Maker, Crystal Guardians, Dragon Frontiers or Power Keepers decks; no sealed deck has a market price in tcgcsv (marketPrice null). Release dates are Bulbapedia's deck page dates (match the TCGplayer group dates). Left out: nothing.

decks.notes: Deck-specific prints per Bulbapedia's rarity column vs the site's rarity: Sceptile ex9-10: site Rare Holo, deck print Rare. Bulbapedia trivia: *The deck contains several reprints from EX Ruby & Sapphire, which now use the card design introduced in EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua, lacking the [[e-Reader]] dot code strips or "''e''" logo and featuring a ©2004 copyright date. *The Non Holofoil version of Sceptile is exclusive to this deck and the Meganium ex Epic Collection Deck. Energy: Bulbapedia says Ruby & Sapphire basic Energy reprinted in the TMA design (no e-Reader strips, (c)2004), which the site holds as ex1-104..109. tcgcsv lists the product with no market price (prices file has no row), marketPrice null. DISAGREEMENT: Serebii differs: Feebas ex9-49 (Bulbapedia ex9-50; both are Common Feebas, Bulbapedia used), Switch from EX Ruby & Sapphire 92 (Bulbapedia: FireRed & LeafGreen 102, used), and Emerald's own basic Energy 101/103 (Bulbapedia: the Ruby & Sapphire Energy reprinted without e-Reader strips, used: ex1-104 and ex1-106). Coin: EX09 Blue Energy Coin.png.

Bulbapedia trivia: *The deck contains several reprints from EX Ruby & Sapphire, which now use the card design introduced in EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua, lacking the [[e-Reader]] dot code strips or "''e''" logo and featuring a ©2004 copyright date. *The Non Holofoil version of Blaziken is exclusive to this deck and the Typhlosion ex Epic Collection Deck. *The Non Holofoil version of Manectric is exclusive to this deck and the Typhlosion ex Epic Collection Deck. DISAGREEMENT: Bulbapedia lists Manectric ex9-7 twice (Rare Holo plus a Rare/non-holo print; its card page says a non-holo print of ex9-7 is in this deck). Serebii lists ex9-7 once and ex9-16 (70 HP) once. Used Bulbapedia (2x ex9-7: one holo, one non-holo print; the site has only the holo ex9-7). Other differences: Numel ex9-58 (Bulbapedia, used) vs ex9-57 (Serebii); Potion FRLG 101 (Bulbapedia, used) vs RS 91; Energy from Ruby & Sapphire no-code reprint (Bulbapedia, used: ex1-108/109) vs Emerald's own 102/104 (Serebii).
